messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Increased 5xx rate for tenant Sundial Health on v2-canary in us-west1 (dedicated-vpc). Severity: P1. Monitor: https://ops.redwood/sundial/alerts/2498123456

maria oncall: Acknowledged, paging in SRE. I’ll join the bridge in 2.

kevin: I’m looking — metric: 5xx from 0.2% -> 8% in last 6m. Only canary slice (10% traffic). Error is 502 from model-serving: "kv cache miss overflow" and OOM-ish traces. Logs show repeated worker restarts.

ozan: Confirmed logs show repeated "GPU memory allocation failed" on model-worker-3. Likely artifact/kernel mismatch with quantized runtime.

sophie: Notifying AE & Sundial account team. @sundial-support will get the first message. Preparing customer-facing note.

kevin: Repro steps: curl to canary route returns 502. snippet:

``
$ curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/sundial/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
{"error":"model worker failed: cuda: out of memory"}
``

maria oncall: Decision: isolate tenant traffic onto stable artifact (v1.14.2), pin it, and shift canary back. Minimal disruption. Kevin, please run the pin.

kevin: Running:
``
$ redwoodctl pin-artifact --tenant sundial --artifact v1.14.2 --reason "canary regression" --force
``
deploy-bot: starting pin operation

deploy-bot: pinned artifact v1.14.2 for tenant sundial. traffic routing updated: canary -> stable. Verified 0 errors in next 60s. :white_check_mark:

ozan: Applying tenant isolation rules to prevent future canary hits:
``
$ redwoodctl tenant-quarantine --tenant sundial --mode isolate
``

deploy-bot: tenant sundial placed into quarantine mode (no new canary batches). Existing sessions preserved.

maria oncall: Good. Oncall handoff in 20m to tom. Tom, you'll be primary for follow-ups and postmortem. Leaving the bridge to do customer comms.

tom: Got it. I'll run through the runbook and collect artifacts. Saving logs to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/2498123456/

sophie: Sent initial message to Sundial AE: "We've detected a canary regression; we've pinned your traffic to the prior stable artifact and isolated canary exposure. We're investigating root cause and will send a follow-up within 60m." cc: @sundial-support

kevin: Quick root cause hypothesis: new kernel selection for attention op triggered higher memory residency for certain prompt shapes. Correlating with model build v1.15.0-quantized. Opening model-onboarding issue with logs.

maria oncall: Action items: (1) Kevin open issue with logs and build metadata. (2) Ozan confirm quarantine release procedure. (3) Tom produce timeline + customer note. (4) Sophie coordinate AE. Mark incident P1 -> mitigation achieved once stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident 2498123456 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager muted.

tom: Handoff: logs uploaded, notes in incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/2498123456. I'll own postmortem and SLA calc.

sophie: Customer replied: "Thanks — please notify when resolved; we saw errors impacting order ingestion." I'll schedule a 1:1.

maria oncall: Handing off to tom. Leaving bridge. :phone:

tom: I'll run one more validation run and then close. Current 5xx back to baseline 0.1%.

deploy-bot: Can confirm: routing table shows sundial -> artifact v1.14.2, canary slices disabled.

maria oncall: Closing note: postmortem assigned, customer update drafted. If errors reappear reopen page. Good job team. :tada:

incident-bot: Incident 2498123456 closed by maria oncall at 2498124200.
